_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic page, spare knowing ink line with soft watercolor in muted ochre, slate blue and misty sea-foam green, Pacific Northwest coastal light, economy of line, quiet composition. model sheet of a man in his mid-forties with a receding hairline and unkempt brown hair at the sides, stubble, tired kind eyes, blue plaid flannel open over a charcoal band tee with a faded wing graphic, ripped faded jeans, brown boots, slight stoop; front view, back view, reflection-in-glass view, walking-away view; a small rainbow songbird at his feet; labeled WOOD 2024. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, saturated color, neon, anime, busy composition, watermark, extra fingers
